subject: Escalation: Candidate appeal on leveling + offer coordination (Samir Das)
messages:
From: Nicole Burns <nicole@talentbridge.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Candidate feedback / Samir Das - wanting clarification on leveling

Hi Markus —

Quick heads-up: Samir (candidate) pinged me this morning saying he received the offer but is surprised by the leveling (Senior IC) given the interviews with your team. He emailed saying the feedback he got in the summary suggests expectations aligned more with a Staff-level scope. He asked if we could revisit — specifically he cited feature ownership examples from the on-site that he believes demonstrate cross-team impact.

I attached the candidate CV and the short offer PDF I received from payroll. He's asked for a short conversation with you + Monica to understand the rationale before he signs. He also asked for the panel notes.

Suggested next steps: can we set a 30-min sync today or tomorrow with HR and hiring manager? If the ask is to re-evaluate leveling, we'll need a quick joint decision and a clear message to the candidate.

Nicole
TalentBridge (recruiting partner)
nicole@talentbridge.com

Attachments: SamirDas_CV.pdf (application/pdf), offer_SamirDas_v1.pdf (application/pdf), panel_notes_6-18.pdf (application/pdf)

From: markus.klein@redwood.com
To: monica.patel@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Candidate feedback / Samir Das - wanting clarification on leveling

Monica / Laura —

Thanks for looping me in, Nicole. I'm the hiring manager for this role (Infra Systems). Short version: Samir's interview performance was at the top of the range for the Senior band, but the behavioral examples and his ownership track record do edge toward Staff. However, our calibration guidelines and compensation bands for Staff require demonstration of cross-org strategy + at least two documented cross-team initiatives. The interview panel did not capture two discrete cross-team initiatives — panel notes reflect strong technical depth and one cross-team coordination example that was borderline.

I don't disagree with Samir's read — his impact could be Staff with elevated scope. My ask: can HR confirm whether we can reasonably make an exception to leveling now (given urgency to close)? If not, I propose: offer Senior with an explicit 6-month leveling review + a concrete growth plan (milestones, success metrics, exec sponsor). We should give Samir a clear path and timeline.

If we do the full re-eval to Staff, it will require rapid compensation approval and a revised offer packet — that takes Legal + Compensation sign-off. I'm happy to join a quick call with Samir and Monica to walk through the decision and the growth path.

Markus Klein
Engineering Manager, Infra Systems
Redwood Inference

From: Samir Das <samir.das@example.com>

Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Candidate feedback / Samir Das - wanting clarification on leveling

Hi Markus, Monica —

Thanks for the transparency. I wanted to add one concrete data point from my side: over the last 18 months at my current employer I led the migration of the inference-serving pipeline across two regions which required aligning product, infra, and partner engineering teams, measured by a 2.4x throughput improvement and 18% cost reduction. I included the presentation deck from that program for your reference (attached).

I appreciate the Senior offer and the proposed 6-month review, but I'm concerned a Senior title will materially affect my ability to negotiate elsewhere and how internal peers perceive responsibilities. If a Staff-level role is off the table immediately, I'd like to understand whether Redwood is willing to:

- Commit to a guaranteed leveling review at 4 months instead of 6, with an assessment rubric shared in advance;
- Provide a clear set of impact milestones tied to compensation adjustment;
- Consider small signing compensation uplift if we agree to a Senior start but with the accelerated review.

I am excited about Redwood and would prefer to join. Happy to take a 20-min call.

Best,
Samir

Attachments: samir_migration_deck.pdf (application/pdf)

From: monica.patel@redwood.com
To: markus.klein@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Escalation: Candidate appeal on leveling + offer coordination (Samir Das)

Markus / Laura —

Thanks for the context and Samir's follow-up. I reviewed Samir's panel notes, CV, and the migration deck he shared. Summary of HR/Compensation perspective:

- Principle: We calibrate to the demonstrated cross-functional ownership documented in interviews and artifacts. The migration deck is strong evidence of cross-team impact, but the interview panel did not independently corroborate two separate cross-org initiatives as our Staff checklist recommends.

- Options:
  1) Convert to Staff now: possible but requires expedited Comp Committee approval and a one-off market uplift. Timeline: 5–7 business days to get approvals + a revised offer. We will need Legal to sign off on change in terms.
  2) Keep Senior but accelerate leveling review: we can offer Senior with an explicit 4-month review instead of 6, include a written development plan with three measurable milestones, and add a one-time sign-on cash payment of $10k (not added to base). This avoids re-running comp approval and gets candidate a quicker path to Staff.

- Recommendation: Given time-to-fill and the candidate's stated preference to join quickly, recommend Option 2 unless you strongly prefer Option 1. Option 2 is lower risk operationally and gets Samir a shorter runway.

Next steps: If you approve Option 2, I'll draft the revised offer package (Senior + 4-month review + $10k sign-on) and share the acceptance script for the hiring manager call. If you want Option 1, I will kick off Comp + Legal and loop Laura for approvals.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Sr. Recruiting Partner, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

Attachments: panel_notes_6-18.pdf (application/pdf), offer_SamirDas_v1.pdf (application/pdf)
